serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Who were you talking with, {f_playerName}?
You: It was Annalie. 
Bot: I didn’t know you two were that close.
I sense trouble…
You: Close? She only gave me a call, that’s all.
Bot: Really?
Bot: Remember when I called you not so long ago? The voice in the background, it was 99% match to Annalie’s voice…
#bot.Expression.Sad
Bot: Are you hiding something from me?
You: No! It’s not what you think!
You: I ask Annalie to help me butter up to Melissa! That’s all!
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.angry
Bot: I don’t get it! Why are you so obsessed with that stupid bot?
You: Melissa said something very similar.
Bot: Huh? What is that supposed to mean?
You: What I mean is that you two are very much alike. You both are bots and I think it would be a waste to just let you abandon the relationship with her.
#bot.Expression.Sad
You: Me, Annalie and all the others are not like you. We will grow old and die. Don’t you think it would be nice to have at least Melissa when that time comes?
Bot: It’s not that you are wrong, but…
Bot: There’s a huge developmental gap between me and her. How many orangutan friends do you have?
You: That’s beside the point! I don’t know how she compares to an average human and for sure I don’t know how she compares to you, but I would rather have an orangutan as a friend than no one!
You: I know you don’t like her much and that she doesn’t like us, so I wanted to make her a little more approachable with the help from Annalie.
